authorization: User explicitly asks to feed existing project simulated data into colleague program
data: data/驱动因素解耦模拟数据集_v2, internal 2.4
scope: Independent factorial tasks, not a fabricated hourly history; colleague DML core reused without source modification
sample: All 3456 tasks, including unauthorized, declined, zero/failed delivery
outcome: Observed completion_ratio, in fraction units; reported effects multiplied by 100 as percentage points

treatment.encoding: three treatment indicators; no synthetic green/AGC/reference-price/survey fields

encoding: Train-derived sorted resource vocabulary, drop-first onehot; continuous fields retained; scaling fit on training only; no missing input admitted
excluded_predictors: assignment probability as an effect predictor
inner_split: GroupKFold 3 on training aggregation_id; no validation/test rows in nuisance/final/preprocessing fitting

nuisance.treatment_model: learned m(X); 0.25 is marginal factorial allocation, not asserted conditional propensity

baselines: B_CONSTANT: training observed arm mean minus training reference arm mean
B_OLS: same train-scaled features, treatment indicators and their interactions, least squares
identification_gate: Colleague identification_report must be ok before any final-stage DML fit; also check each train-type/arm and fold train/test counts
prediction_policy: No clipping, price monotonicity enforcement, zeroing known-null types, test-driven tuning or selection; all prespecified models reported

evaluation.reference: 03_counterfactual_truth_evaluation_only: potential_completion_ratio(price) minus potential_completion_ratio(0.4), joined only after predictions saved
evaluation.primary: overall, 16 type, and aggregation mean-effect bias by contrast; equal-type mean absolute bias, in percentage points
evaluation.secondary: individual realized potential contrast MAE/RMSE; this includes latent threshold/cost heterogeneity and is not pure conditional-mean estimation error
evaluation.negative_control: PV and storage: true price contrast zero; report absolute error and fraction with abs(predicted effect)>0.05 (5 percentage points), no significance claim
evaluation.confidence_intervals: not reported: train only 3 and test only 2 aggregation clusters
evaluation.validation_usage: report only; no tuning or model selection

excluded_scope: original hourly baseline and future price features
source_qa_note: File schema and factual-potential correspondence inspected before fitting. Reserved test is an entity/aggregation fitting holdout, not claimed entirely unseen source data.
